name: What steps should I take if my home listing expires?

mainEntity.name: What steps should I take if my home listing expires?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your listing expires, the first step is to communicate with your current agent to understand their perspective on why it didn't sell and discuss potential adjustments. This is a key preparation step to determine your next course of action. You should also review feedback from showings, re-evaluate your home's condition, consider a professional appraisal, and research comparable sales in your specific area, such as Palm Beach County or Collier County, to ensure your pricing strategy is competitive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Review feedback, re-evaluate pricing and condition, and discuss a new strategy with your agent or consider a new one.
